scenarios.name: Small ticket
scenarios.when_to_use: one file or one clear fix

scenarios.name: Medium ticket
scenarios.when_to_use: one Project, a handful of files (the go-sandbox Goal, #174, was this size)

scenarios.name: Big ticket
scenarios.branch: `/architect` + `/arena` on the contested ticket, hanging off `/implement-spec`
scenarios.when_to_use: several PRs or more than one Project
scenarios.proof: spec, tickets with blocking edges, per-ticket check and review

scenarios.name: Huge or unknown shape
scenarios.when_to_use: more than one session can hold
scenarios.proof: the map issue and its resolved decision tickets

scenarios.name: POC / Experiment

flow.step: Experiment request (`experiments/<slug>/request.md`: a claim, pass/fail checks, cost cap); `prototype` can stand in for it
if kept, re-enter as a Medium ticket

scenarios.when_to_use: testing a claim or a shape
scenarios.proof: `results.md`, recorded whether it passed or failed

scenarios.name: Bug
scenarios.proof: the test that failed before and passes after

flow.step: `/figure-it-out` contract: goal, done means, fresh worktree, escape hatch
per ticket: as Hybrid A's build half
morning audit: `code-review` by a different model
